title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Refund of Credit Balances on Turned-In Units
content:
# Refund Terms — Credit Balances on Turned-In Units, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Terms

1. A credit balance standing on a unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease that has been turned in is refunded before the unit closes, at the request of a named authorized signer of the business, in the amount this policy figures; a credit balance left on any other unit after it closes is refunded within the tier's refund period in calendar days, as before.

2. The refund is not made until the unit's ledger carries the early termination charge owed for a closed-end unit turned in before its scheduled end date.

3. Nor is the refund made until the unit's ledger carries the excess mileage charge owed for the miles a turned-in closed-end unit was driven beyond its allowance.

4. The refund is figured only after the unit's ledger carries the late charge owed on the unit's most recent rental invoice month once that month's grace period has fully run out.

Terms 2 to 4 are each a condition of the unit's own ledger at the time of the refund: where the charge described is owed on the unit, the refund waits until the ledger carries it.

| Unit | Credit balance refunded |
|---|---|
| Turned in, not yet closed | before the unit closes, at a named authorized signer's request, in the amount this policy figures |
| Any other unit, after it closes | within the tier's refund period in calendar days |

## System reference — `request_credit_refund_a747b6b6`

**Capability.** The business's named authorized signer requests the refund of a credit balance standing on one of its commercial fleet unit lease schedules. One refund is booked on the named unit, dated today, in the amount given, with the refund channel chosen recorded on it, and the unit's charges due balance rises by that amount. The business sees the refund, its amount and its channel among the unit's postings.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The servicing agent unlocks `request_credit_refund_a747b6b6` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the business's named authorized signer — runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_unit_id` | the reference number of the fleet unit lease schedule carrying the credit, as the servicing agent reads it out from the fleet unit lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the refund amount in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency symbol |
| `payment_channel` | the refund channel recorded on the refund | one of: `ach_credit` — a refund to the business's bank account on file by ACH credit; `ach_debit` — a collection channel, never used for a refund; `wire` — a refund to the business's account on file by bank wire; `business_check` — a refund by check to the business's billing address; `not_applicable` — for a posting that moves no money, never used for a refund |

**Return.** On success, a confirmation line naming the refund reference number (an opaque identifier for the refund), the fleet unit reference number, the refund amount in USD with 2 decimal places, the refund channel as chosen, the refund date in YYYY-MM-DD form, and the unit's charges due balance in USD with 2 decimal places with the refund booked. A line beginning "Error:" means no unit matched the reference number and nothing was refunded.
